function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
**Columbia University** is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States and has a strong reputation for academic excellence, research, and public service.

| **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, New York City (main campus), with additional campuses in Upper Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Qatar. |
| **Founding year** | 1754 (as King's College) |
| **Type** | Private research university |
| **Ivy League member** | Yes |
| **Student population** | Approximately 30,000 students (undergraduate, graduate, and professional). |
| **Academic structure** | 10 schools and colleges, including Columbia College (undergraduate), School of Engineering & Applied Science, School of Business (CBS), School of Journalism, School of Law, School of Medicine, School of Social Work, Graduate School of Arts & Sciences, etc. |
